{{Top|leg}}
The '''largest island''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] was the location of [[the Point]], a section of [[Water/Legends|ocean]] where two strong currents met. Sailors navigating the Point had to be skilled in their craft, and the course of the [[Spira Regatta Open]] made vessels round the Point.
